t: The Magnusson Line 350 S rechargeable headlamp provides hands-free illumination for trade professionals during intricate tasks. This LED head torch delivers up to 350 lumens, combining a wide-angle COB floodlight with a focused spotlight for long-distance visibility up to 20 metres. Ideal for electricians working in dark consumer units or mechanics in automotive workshops, the unit features a wave sensor for touchless control. Powered by a USB-C rechargeable battery, it offers runtime between 2.5 and 8 hours. An adjustable elastic headband ensures a secure and comfortable fit, making it perfect for daily domestic use.
